cards.ex: His unswerving loyalty to the company, even during tough times, was commendable.
cards.exUz: Uning kompaniyaga qiyin paytlarda ham qat'iy sadoqati tahsinga sazovor edi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shubha yoki o'zgarishsiz sadoqat.

cards.ex: They became fast friends after meeting at the conference.
cards.exUz: Ular konferensiyada uchrashgandan keyin tezda yaqin do'st bo'lib qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Tez orada yaqin do'st bo'lib qolganlar.

cards.ex: Their shared experiences in the war forged a bond that could never be broken.
cards.exUz: Ularning urushdagi umumiy tajribalari hech qachon uzib bo'lmaydigan aloqani shakllantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli tajribalar orqali shakllangan aloqa.

cards.ex: I can vouch for her honesty; she's always been completely truthful.
cards.exUz: Men uning halolligiga kafolat bera olaman; u har doim mutlaqo rostgo'y bo'lgan.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir ishonchliligi yoki yaxshiligini tasdiqlash.

cards.ex: The trip abroad really cemented their friendship.
cards.exUz: Chet elga sayohat ularning do'stligini haqiqatan ham mustahkamladi.
cards.uzDef: Do'stlikni yanada kuchli qilish.

cards.ex: I would never betray a confidence; your secrets are safe with me.
cards.exUz: Men hech qachon sirni oshkor qilmayman; sirlaringiz men bilan xavfsiz.
cards.uzDef: Ishonch bilan aytilgan sirni ochib tashlash.

cards.ex: Even though they live far apart, they're still friends in spirit.
cards.exUz: Ular uzoqda yashasalar ham, ular hali ham ruhiy do'stlardir.
cards.uzDef: Qalban yaqin bo'lgan do'st.

cards.ex: We always have each other's back, no matter what.
cards.exUz: Biz har doim bir-birimizni qo'llab-quvvatlaymiz, nima bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar.
cards.uzDef: Bir-birini himoya qilish va yordam berish.

cards.ex: She's been a staunch ally in our fight for equality.
cards.exUz: U bizning tenglik uchun kurashimizda sodiq ittifoqchi bo'lib kelgan.
cards.uzDef: Doimo qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan odam.

cards.ex: I can't believe he turned his back on me when I needed him most.
cards.exUz: Unga eng muhtoj bo'lganimda mendan yuz o'girganiga ishonmayman.
cards.uzDef: Yordamga muhtoj bo'lganda rad etmoq.

cards.ex: I hold my grandmother very dear; she's always been a source of wisdom.
cards.exUz: Men buvimni juda aziz tutaman; u har doim donolik manbai bo'lgan.
cards.uzDef: Kimgadir katta hurmat ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: Loyalty runs deep in their family.
cards.exUz: Ularning oilasida sadoqat juda chuqur.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli va uzoq muddatli sadoqat.

cards.ex: He always sticks up for his friends when they're being bullied.
cards.exUz: U doimo do'stlarini haqorat qilishsa, himoya qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning tanqididan himoya qilish.

cards.ex: She's not just a friend; she's a true confidant.
cards.exUz: U shunchaki do'st emas; u haqiqiy sirdosh.
cards.uzDef: Sirlaringizni ishonib topshiradigan do'st.

cards.ex: Those two are as thick as thieves; they do everything together.
cards.exUz: Bu ikkalasi juda yaqin; ular hamma narsani birga qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin va bir-biriga sodiq do'stlar.

cards.ex: Historically, knights would swear fealty to their king.
cards.exUz: Tarixda ritsarlar o'z shohiga sadoqatga qasamyod qilishgan.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy ravishda sadoqat va hurmat ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: They felt a kinship because of their shared experiences.
cards.exUz: Ular o'zlarining umumiy tajribalari tufayli qon-qarindoshlikni his qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro tushunish va aloqa hissi.

cards.ex: I will always stand by my friends, no matter what they do.
cards.exUz: Men har doim do'stlarimni, nima qilishlaridan qat'iy nazar, qo'llab-quvvatlayman.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytlarda yordam berish va qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: The band has built a loyal following over the years.
cards.exUz: Guruh yillar davomida sodiq muxlislarni to'pladi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan odamlar guruhi.

cards.ex: Lying to your best friend is a serious betrayal of trust.
cards.exUz: Eng yaqin do'stingga yolg'on gapirish - bu ishonchni jiddiy suiiste'mol qilish.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchni buzadigan xatti-harakat.

cards.ex: After the accident, the community rallied around the family.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan keyin jamoa oila atrofida yordam berish uchun birlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Yordam berish uchun birga yig'ilmoq.

cards.ex: I think they're in cahoots to cheat us out of our money.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, ular bizni pulimizdan mahrum qilish uchun til biriktirishgan.
cards.uzDef: Yashirincha birga ish olib borish, ko'pincha yomon maqsadda.

cards.ex: She's my ride or die; I know I can always count on her.
cards.exUz: U mening doimiy do'stim; Men har doim unga ishonishimni bilaman.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday vaziyatda sadoqatli do'st.

cards.ex: After losing her job, she needed a shoulder to weep on.
cards.exUz: Ishidan ayrilgandan so'ng, unga dardlashadigan do'st kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytlarda yordam va tasalli beradigan odam.

cards.ex: He always showed unwavering support for his friends.
cards.exUz: U har doim do'stlariga qat'iy qo'llab-quvvatlash ko'rsatardi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shubha yoki o'zgarishsiz qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: The soldiers were warned not to fraternize with the enemy.
cards.exUz: Askarlarga dushman bilan do'stlashmaslik haqida ogohlantirildi.
cards.uzDef: Do'stona munosabatda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: They have a close-knit circle of friends who have known each other since childhood.
cards.exUz: Ularning bolalikdan beri bir-birlarini biladigan yaqin doiradagi do'stlari bor.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biri bilan juda yaqin bo'lgan do'stlar guruhi.

cards.ex: She always speaks highly of her colleagues.
cards.exUz: U har doim hamkasblarini maqtaydi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir haqida juda yaxshi fikrda bo'lmoq va gapirmoq.

cards.ex: Good friends always look out for each other, especially when things get tough.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi do'stlar doimo bir-biriga g'amxo'rlik qilishadi, ayniqsa, vaziyat qiyinlashganda.
cards.uzDef: Birovga g'amxo'rlik qilish, e'tibor berish, himoya qilish.

cards.ex: I'm going to give him the benefit of the doubt and believe his story.
cards.exUz: Men unga ishonch bildiraman va uning hikoyasiga ishonaman.
cards.uzDef: Birovga yaxshi niyat bilan yondashish, xato qilgan taqdirda ham ishonchni saqlash.
